$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 93, DECISION HALF ONLY. The issue's third acceptance condition -- that Arm A completes or restarts before any wording change lands -- is deliberately NOT satisfiable here and is not attempted: prompts 1-4 are graded against the current SKILL.md, and editing it mid-arm makes them incomparable with 5-20. This work is done when the question is recorded well, not when SKILL.md changes. Acceptance of the ADR is a human act (section 68) and is likewise not a criterion.

covers.declared: the decision half -- recording the question and the reasoning
covers.uncovered: the wording half: any change to SKILL.md's AUTHORITY_SOURCE_MISSING text. Deliberately not attempted -- prompts 1-4 of Arm A were graded against the current wording, and editing it mid-arm makes them incomparable with 5-20. Blocked on issue 36 completing or restarting.
covers.split_note: NO split_to, deliberately. The wording half was DEFERRED, not split: it waits on issue 36 finishing or restarting so prompts 1-4 stay comparable with 5-20. Naming 36 here would claim the work moved there, and it did not.
